ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a food web. On the right side there is a moose labeled “Moose”, with “primary consumer” marked beside it. Below Moose, it is connected by an arrow to “branches” (tree branches), and above/to the upper left it is connected to “Brown Bear”; Brown Bear is located at the top of the figure and is labeled “secondary consumer”. Reasoning: The question asks “what would a change in moose most affect”. Judging according to the direct relationships in the food web, Moose and Brown Bear have a direct feeding relationship; Brown Bear is the consumer connected to Moose, therefore a change in Moose would most directly and most obviously affect Brown Bear.
